findings.problem: The English is passive ('Set once the conversation starts': the choice is made when the conversation starts). 即可设置 states a permission — 'you can then set it' — moving the agent from the system to the reader, and the key's en sidecar says the line must not read as an instruction. It is the only one of the seven locales that is not passive (es Se establece, fr Défini, ru Задаётся, vi Sẽ được thiết lập, hi तय होगा, ur طے ہو جائے گا). Not escalated to major: the wording is idiomatic, true of the product, and asks nothing unsafe of the reader.
